messages:
Maya Patel: Quick postmortem follow-up from inc-5829 — we've tripped a new regression cluster causing streaming reconnect loops & partial responses during sustained load. Need to lock owners, concrete timelines, and add recurring checks. TL;DR: reconnect logic + timeout tuning + overload fallback.

Dom Castillo: Can we get the minimal repro and logs? I pushed raw logs to /shared/inc-5829/logs (https://files.redwood/internal/inc-5829/logs). The pattern looks like: client SYN -> server ack -> long pause -> client reconnect. Suspect KV cache eviction spikes. @Liam can you look at kernel-level logs? :eyes: 

Liam O'Connor: I'll take lead on reconnect logic. Plan: reproduce locally, instrument handshake timing, add extra debug at accept path. ETA: initial findings by EOD tomorrow. Assigning myself: 'reconnect-investigation'.

Sophie Nguyen: I'll own QA harness + nightly regression tests for streaming. I'll add a synthetic load test that simulates 100 concurrent clients with intermittent network flaps. ETA: test infra by Fri COB.

Ezra Kim: Suggest adding circuit-breaker and backoff at proxy + server side: increase default handshake timeout from 10s -> 15s, add jitter, and add fallback route to 'non-streaming' path on repeated failures. I'll sketch config: ```yaml
handshake_timeout: 15s
backoff:
  base: 200ms
  max: 5s
  jitter: true
```

Dom Castillo: We should also surface a new SLO alert: streaming_reconnect_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> page. Who owns alerts?

Sophie Nguyen: I can create the alert in Datadog and add runbook link. Runbook draft at https://confluence/internal/streaming-reconnect-runbook

PagerBot: INCIDENT inc-5829 updates: pager assigned -> Maya, oncall -> Dom. https://incidents.redwood/5829

Maya Patel: Action item list: 1) Reconnect logic root cause (Liam) — due 2026-03-27 2) QA harness (Sophie) — due 2026-03-26 3) Timeout/backoff config change (Ezra) — due 2026-03-25 4) SLO alert + runbook (Sophie) — due 2026-03-24 5) Post-change canary + monitor (Dom) — due 2026-03-28. Please ack with :white_check_mark: and update if dates conflict.

Liam O'Connor: :white_check_mark: taking 1. Note: I might need help from eng-runtime for kernel hooks — @Dom can you provide access?

Dom Castillo: :white_check_mark: will provide kernel logs + a quick patching script. Also will add a temporary increase to handshake timeout on the staging fleet to validate.

Ezra Kim: I'll open a PR with the config patch and a togglable feature flag `streaming.reconnect.backoff.v1` so we can roll forward/back. PR -> https://git.redwood/reconnect-pr-123 :rocket:

Sophie Nguyen: :white_check_mark: I'll add tests and create the Datadog alert. Also will add a monthly job to run the regression harness.

Maya Patel: Noted. One more ask: let's capture recurrence patterns in a small doc — frequency, affected model sizes, region. I'll draft a short table. If anyone has historical markers, drop them here.

Liam O'Connor: Found 3 prior incidents matching signature (inc-4981, inc-5120, inc-5362) — seems to spike on heavy 4k token sessions. Will add to the doc.

Dom Castillo: Oncall observed region eu-west-1 had higher rate yesterday at 11:03 UTC; suspect noisy neighbor there.

Sophie Nguyen: Putting all action items into ticket INC-5829-REM with owners + due dates. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5829-REM

Maya Patel: Thanks team. We'll review progress in tomorrow's 10:30 sync. If anyone hits blockers DM me. Closing thread for new assignments after patch lands. :pray:
